usage: The word 嘴 (zeoi2) is a noun that primarily refers to the beak of birds but can also mean mouth in everyday speech.
嘴 (zeoi2) is often used to talk about the shape or function of a bird's beak, such as how it eats or sings.
In casual contexts, 嘴 (zeoi2) can extend metaphorically to human mouths, especially when talking about talking or eating.
嘴 (zeoi2) does not change form for singular or plural – the same word is used regardless of how many beaks or mouths are meant.
When combined with verbs, 嘴 (zeoi2) can describe actions related to biting, eating, or talking.
